mapper.select: SELECT id, phone, scene, code, expire_at, used, created_at FROM t_sms_code WHERE phone = #{phone} AND scene = #{scene} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_sms_code (phone, scene, code, expire_at, used, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{phone}, #{scene}, #{code}, #{expireAt}, #{used}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
